Subject: Partnership proposal — ClosedLoop x Redwood (instrumentation & embed runtime)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick call yesterday. ClosedLoop is excited about the potential to co-build an embedded runtime + tracing integration with Redwood that would make our prompt-engineering suite first-class on your platform.

High-level asks from our side:
- LangChain/LlamaIndex friendly connector that preserves token attribution across reroutes.
- Tracing hook that emits spans with model, model_variant, request_id, and token_count.
- Optional prefix/KV-cache compatibility so our multi-step prompts don't blow up latency.

I'm attaching a short SOW draft to frame scope and timing. Can your team review and flag anything that looks like a hard blocker?

Attachments: [ClosedLoop_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Hi Sofia / team,

Thanks — quick answers inline and a couple of artifacts attached.

1) Trace schema: we prefer a lightweight JSON envelope with fields: timestamp, span_id, parent_id, service (closedloop), model, model_variant, request_id, token_delta, user_role. I'll drop a 1-page example in the Drive link.
2) Compatibility: initial launch will target Redwood hosted API and Dedicated customers — we want the connector to be portable to Private but can phase that to phase 2.
3) Sandbox: sandbox data is synthetic by default; we need a 30-day retention window and the ability to purge on request (SOC / audit).

I've provisioned a sandbox account and put instructions in the attached TXT. Login: sandbox@closedloop.example (password shared by SSO invite).

Attachments: [closedloop-sandbox-instructions.txt (text/plain)]

Looking forward to the sync on Tue 11/10 10:00am PT — we'll include our lead engineer on the call.

—Priya

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: ClosedLoop SOW quick technical notes

Vanessa / Sofia — quick internal checklist after reading the draft SOW and Priya's note. Quoting Ari below for context.

On Sat, 7 Nov 2026 at 09:12, Ari Kaplan <ari@closedlooplabs.com> wrote:
> High-level asks from our side:
> - LangChain/LlamaIndex friendly connector that preserves token attribution across reroutes.
> - Tracing hook that emits spans with model, model_variant, request_id, and token_count.
> - Optional prefix/KV-cache compatibility so our multi-step prompts don't blow up latency.

My read / risks: 
- Token attribution: we'll need to ensure our inference runtime surfaces per-request token attribution when using tracing; may require minor changes to our token accounting API (low-risk).
- Tracing: we can add a span emitter in the gateway layer; need to confirm labeling to match ClosedLoop schema.
- KV cache: works but may affect latency SLOs for small tail-latency sensitive customers — propose toggleable cache compatibility and a test harness that measures tail-p99.

Acceptance criteria I'd propose (for SOW):
- LangChain connector PR merged to our examples repo + CI that runs 5 integration scenarios.
- Tracing hook producing spans for 95% of requests in the sandbox for 48h of churn testing.
- Performance regression <= 10% p50 and <= 15% p95 vs baseline for instrumented requests.

I'll prep a short tech agenda for the sync and pull in an infra engineer if the sandbox needs firewall work.

-Jonas

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@closedlooplabs.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@closedlooplabs.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

2) Technical: Jonas to draft acceptance criteria (Jonas will add the bullet list above to the SOW appendix). ClosedLoop to confirm trace labels and provide the sample JSON schema in Drive by Wed 11/11.

4) Timeline: target M1 for connector prototype (hosted + dedicated compatibility split) and M2 for extended Private compatibility evaluation.
5) Legal/Compliance: Vanessa to loop in Legal on data retention/purge language for sandbox (30-day window requested).

Action owners: Vanessa (commercial redlines), Jonas (acceptance criteria + tech appendix), Priya (schema + engineer), Marissa (infra ticket), Sofia (exec sponsor / cadence).
